meaning: Motor error: the tub failed to spin, so the motor cannot operate properly.
causes: Washer overloaded and the motor strained
Coin or foreign object stuck in the tub
diySteps: Unplug the power cord, wait 5 minutes and try the cycle again
Reduce the load and select the bedding cycle for a heavy load or large blankets
Turn off the power, unload the washer and look for a coin or other object stuck in the tub; remove it with pliers or tweezers
safetyNote: Unplug the washer (or switch off its breaker) and close the water taps before you reach behind it, handle hoses or open a filter. Water left from a recent hot cycle can be very hot, so let it cool first. Never bypass the door lock. Motor, pump, valve, sensor and control-board repairs belong to a qualified appliance technician.
proAdvice: If the washer keeps showing LE, unplug it and contact LG service.
